infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: HereNow uses your location to show venues near you and to confirm you are at a venue when you check in.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: HereNow uses your location in the background only to check you out of a venue automatically after you leave it. You always check in yourself.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: HereNow uses your location in the background only to check you out of a venue automatically after you leave it. You always check in yourself.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: HereNow uses your photo library so you can choose a profile photo or attach photos to posts, the Board and venue announcements.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HereNow uses your camera so you can take a profile photo or attach a photo to a post, the Board or a venue announcement.

web.name: HereNow
web.description: Connect where you are. Check in to venues, meet people IRL, and see who's out tonight.
